name: agents-domain
description: Domain specialist agents for languages and frameworks: TypeScript, Go, React, Next.js, Electron, embedded systems, fullstack, game development, mobile and WebSocket engineering. Deliberately not forgeplan-aware — they advise on code, not on the artifact graph. Use when the question is idiomatic within one stack, where a generalist answers plausibly but not idiomatically. Full history in CHANGELOG.md.
